aboutText:
UTCar is a pioneering automotive research and innovation platform dedicated to developing sustainable and cutting-edge vehicle technologies. Our team of engineers and researchers work collaboratively to design innovative solutions that push the boundaries of performance, safety, and environmental responsibility.
We strive to create vehicles that are not only efficient and technologically advanced but also accessible and user-friendly. Through rigorous testing, community engagement, and continuous learning, UTCar aims to shape the future of transportation and inspire the next generation of automotive enthusiasts.
aboutenv: Electric and eco-friendly vehicle design focusing on sustainable energy solutions and minimal environmental impact.
aboutsensor: High-precision sensors combined with AI-driven decision making for real-time environmental awareness.
aboutinno: Cutting-edge autonomous technology enabling safer roads through intelligent navigation and obstacle avoidance.
decisionmaking: Developing intelligent decision-making algorithms for autonomous systems that can navigate complex scenarios safely and efficiently.
decisionIntro:
Our decision-making module forms the brain of the autonomous system, processing sensor data and making real-time navigation choices.
We employ reinforcement learning, path planning algorithms, and behavior prediction models to ensure safe and efficient autonomous driving.
simulation: Creating virtual environments to test robot behavior and system performance before real-world deployment.
simulationIntro:
Creating virtual environments to test robot behavior and system performance.
We build physics-based and scenario-driven simulators using CARLA, Highway-Env, and custom environments to validate algorithms before real-world deployment.
sensorp: Integrating cameras, IMUs, Light Distance and other sensors for real-time data collection and environmental perception.
sensorsIntro:
Integrating cameras, IMUs, Light Distance and other sensors for real-time data collection.
We develop calibration, synchronization and fusion pipelines to produce robust perception inputs for downstream decision-making modules.
hardware: Assembling electronics, mechanical parts, and embedded systems into final autonomous vehicles.
hardwareIntro:
Building the physical foundation of our autonomous systems through careful integration of mechanical and electronic components.
Our hardware team designs custom PCBs, motor controllers, and sensor mounts to create a reliable and efficient autonomous platform.
cv: Using computer vision modules to perceive the environment and make informed low-level decisions.
cvIntro:
We design computer vision modules to perceive the environment and extract meaningful information from sensors. This information drives both low-level control and high-level decision making.
Our computer vision pipeline consists of 3 core modules for comprehensive scene understanding.

step.carlaDesc: High-fidelity urban driving simulation with realistic physics, weather conditions, and traffic scenarios for testing autonomous driving algorithms.
step.carlaMultiDesc: Training and testing decision-making algorithms in complex multi-agent scenarios with various traffic participants and challenging urban environments.
step.carlaSingleDesc: Focused training environment for individual agent behavior optimization and basic autonomous navigation tasks.
step.highwayDesc: Multi-agent highway driving scenarios for testing lane-change decisions, merging behaviors, and high-speed navigation strategies.
step.gymDesc: Reinforcement learning environment integration for training and benchmarking autonomous driving agents.
step.fusionDesc: Multi-modal sensor fusion combining camera, Light Distance, and IMU data for robust environmental perception.
step.profilingDesc: Real-time profiling and optimization of sensor processing pipelines for embedded deployment.
step.stereoDesc: Dual-camera depth estimation for accurate 3D scene reconstruction and obstacle detection.
step.tofDesc: High-precision distance measurement for close-range obstacle detection and navigation.
step.yoloDesc: Real-time object detection using YOLO architecture for identifying vehicles, pedestrians, and traffic signs.
step.laneDesc: Robust lane marking detection for accurate path planning and lane-keeping assistance.
step.depthDesc: Monocular depth estimation using deep learning for scene understanding without stereo cameras.
step.trackingDesc: Multi-object tracking for maintaining consistent object identities across video frames.
step.rb5Desc: High-performance AI compute platform enabling on-device inference for perception and decision-making algorithms.
step.jetsonDesc: GPU-accelerated edge computing platform for real-time deep learning inference and sensor processing.
step.esp32Desc: Low-power embedded controller for motor control, sensor interfacing, and real-time communication.
